introHtml: Yellow outerwear stands out for high-visibility safety and bold brand presence. Whether you need safety vests for construction crews or branded jackets for outdoor events, yellow ensures your logo is seen from a distance. Polyester shells with reflective accents work well for safety managers, while lightweight pullovers suit marketing giveaways. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for lasting results.
